documents.title: Гюлистанский мирный трактат России с Персией. 12 октября 1813 г.
documents.institution: Министерство иностранных дел Российской империи / Президентская библиотека
documents.publicationCitation: Сборник пограничных договоров, заключенных Россией с соседними государствами. СПб.: МИД, 1891.
documents.notes: Official MFA treaty corpus. The treaty is the legal-basis/signature act; the bilateral ratification exchange is represented separately.

documents.title: Гюлистанский трактат — размен обоюдных ратификаций в Тифлисе
documents.institution: Министерство иностранных дел Российской империи / Президентская библиотека
documents.publicationCitation: Сборник пограничных договоров, заключенных Россией с соседними государствами. СПб.: МИД, 1891.
documents.notes: Official treaty publication records the treaty as confirmed by mutual sovereign ratifications exchanged by the plenipotentiaries in Tiflis on 15 September 1814. This separates treaty signature from bilateral legal confirmation.

documents.title: Туркманчайский мирный трактат России с Персией. 10 февраля 1828 г.
documents.institution: Министерство иностранных дел Российской империи / Президентская библиотека
documents.publicationCitation: Сборник пограничных договоров, заключенных Россией с соседними государствами. СПб.: МИД, 1891; ПСЗРИ, собр. II, т. III, № 1794.
documents.notes: Articles III–V directly cede Erivan and Nakhichevan and define/recognize the new frontier. Several implementation periods run from signature; separate articles postpone the joint demarcation commission and authoritative boundary map until after exchange of ratifications.

documents.title: Генеральная карта земель, между Черным и Каспийским морями лежащих, с означением новой границы России с Персиею
documents.institution: Военно-топографическое депо / Российская национальная библиотека / НЭБ
documents.notes: Contemporary official map explicitly depicting the new Russian-Persian boundary after the Treaty of Turkmenchay. High-priority candidate for georeferencing and promotion to geometry-verified.

documents.title: Адрианопольский мирный договор России с Османской империей. 2 сентября 1829 г.
documents.institution: Министерство иностранных дел Российской империи / Президентская библиотека
documents.publicationCitation: Сборник пограничных договоров, заключенных Россией с соседними государствами. СПб.: МИД, 1891.
documents.notes: Articles III–IV define the European and Asian territorial settlement; Article XI explicitly starts execution of those boundary articles after exchange of ratifications, and Article XVI makes the exchange the final confirmation of the treaty.

documents.title: И. И. Дибич Николаю I о размене ратификаций Адрианопольского мира, 15–16 октября 1829 г.
documents.publicationCitation: Император Николай Павлович и гр. Дибич-Забалканский. Переписка 1828–1830 гг. // Русская старина. 1883.
documents.notes: In the contemporaneous letter dated 15–16 October, Diebitsch first writes that the ratifications brought the previous day will be exchanged 'tomorrow', then continues after the ceremony that he has just returned from the exchange. Used with Articles XI and XVI of the official treaty corpus to fix the effective boundary transition at 16/28 October 1829.

documents.title: Подписан договор о продаже Россией полуострова Аляска Соединённым Штатам Америки
documents.institution: Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
documents.notes: Institutional chronology retained for Russian-language chronology and the 6 (18) October formal transfer ceremony. It is no longer the canonical legal-effect source for the cession itself.

documents.title: Original of Treaty with Russia for Cession of Alaska
documents.institution: Library of Congress / United States National Archives and Records Administration
documents.publicationCitation: Original bilingual English/French Treaty of Cession, National Archives and Records Administration; digital presentation by the Library of Congress.
documents.notes: Article I cedes all Russian territory and dominion in North America immediately upon exchange of ratifications and reproduces the eastern boundary established by the 1825 Anglo-Russian convention. Article IV makes the cession and right of immediate possession complete and absolute at that exchange without waiting for formal delivery.

documents.title: Treaty concerning the Cession of the Russian Possessions in North America
documents.institution: United States Department of State, Office of the Historian
documents.publicationCitation: Papers Relating to Foreign Affairs, Accompanying the Annual Message of the President to the Second Session Fortieth Congress, Part I, pp. 387-392.
documents.notes: Official documentary publication used for article-level legal interpretation and the treaty's geographic boundary description.

documents.title: Certificate of Exchange — Alaska Purchase Treaty
documents.institution: Library of Congress / United States National Archives and Records Administration
documents.publicationCitation: Certificate recording exchange of the instruments of ratification by William H. Seward and Eduard de Stoeckl at Washington, 20 June 1867; original resource at NARA, digital presentation by Library of Congress.
documents.notes: Canonical evidence for the moment at which Articles I and IV make the cession legally complete and confer the right of immediate possession.
